question: Does it matter that TRL ignores the loss_mask wai.export(format='trl') writes?

decontaminate.note: reported but NOT applied: both arms trained on the same 94 rows, so A-B is unaffected

assistant_only_loss: raises: Qwen2.5-Instruct chat template has no {% generation %} block

verdict.leak_preregistered: flat - 0.000 on every arm including base; no resolution (floor effect)
verdict.mean_len: moved - interval excludes zero, both arms outside base band
verdict.headline: The masking choice decisively changes the trained model. At 94 rows the arm honouring the mask is worse (42% stub replies vs 16%), consistent with supervision starvation at 11% of tokens. Direction may reverse with more data; the point is the user is never told which model they trained.
